document.abstract: In the past two weeks, my inbox has been flooded with e-mail about all the amazing (and not so amazing) things that were showcased at the 2017 Consumer Electronics Show. The wide range of topics addressed in this issue of the Journal is indicative of the fact that our industry is pushing the boundaries of technology to support higher resolution (4KUHD and 8KUHD), high dynamic range, brighter display technologies (for better color reproduction), and even virtual reality and its cousin augmented reality.
